messages.text: Shop drawings for the Section 08 44 13 curtain wall mullion detail at the building corner are ready to submit, but what's shown doesn't match what's built out in the field mockup -- can you confirm which governs? This is routine and can be worked into the normal submittal cycle. No cost impact is anticipated. No schedule impact is expected. Please respond within five days so we can proceed with fabrication.
